title: Improved Setup for Decolourization Experiments with Granular and Powdered Adsorbent Materials Using UV-VIS Flow-through Cells
author: Behringer, Hilbig, et al.
materials: The procedure for measuring the adsorption capacity of granulates is similar to that for powders, with slight modifications to accommodate their larger size and prevent physical disintegration. Instead of pouring the powder directly into the liquid, the granulates were weighed and placed into a sampling basket with an appropriate mesh size before the measurement. Once the initial measurement was taken, the basket was lowered into the beaker, allowing the dye solution to flow uniformly through the granulates. Furthermore, the cannula filter prevents small particles from entering the analysis chamber, maintaining measurement accuracy.

steps.title: Stabilise spectrometer and take blanks
steps.instruction: Turn on the UV‑VIS spectrometer and let it stabilise for a few minutes; run a blank measurement with deionised water in the first cell, then run a baseline measurement with deionised water in all cells to remove background signals and correct for optical‑path variations.

steps.title: Load dye solution and set baseline
steps.instruction: Empty the cells, fill them with the dye solution (ensure the dye is completely dissolved), and record the initial measurement without any adsorbent, defining this reading as 100 % dye concentration (c/c₀ = 1) to correct for minor weighing fluctuations.

steps.title: Run timed adsorption measurements
steps.instruction: Perform adsorption scans according to the following schedule, pumping for one minute before each scan to fully replace the liquid:

substeps.instruction: Take the first 10 measurements at 1‑minute intervals.
Take the next 10 measurements at 5‑minute intervals.
Take the final 12 measurements at 10‑minute intervals.
Each measurement per cell lasts 5–20 s.
Note: the one‑minute pump step introduces a systematic delay for short intervals; continuous pumping during measurement removes this delay but may affect the reading.

steps.title: Add adsorbent powder
steps.instruction: Immediately after the initial dye‑only reading, pour the adsorbent powder through the opening into the beaker (cannula filters prevent solids from entering the analysis chamber), then continue monitoring the decolourisation for the desired total duration.

steps.title: Prepare granulate sample in basket
steps.instruction: Weigh the granulate, place it in a sampling basket with an appropriate mesh size, and keep the basket aside until after the initial dye‑only measurement; then lower the basket into the beaker so the dye solution flows uniformly through the granules, with the cannula filter still protecting the analysis chamber.
